app.name: Rustranscript
list.unclassified_hint: Calls without a company or client. Open one and use “Classify”.
list.empty_all: No calls yet. Import the existing transcriptions to get started.
call.title: Title
call.title_hint: Leave empty to show the date.
call.add_glossary_hint: Saves the edit and opens a glossary rule with the original → corrected text
call.finish_first: Save or cancel the passage being edited first.
speaker.rename: Name for “{label}” in the whole call
speaker.rename_hint: Leave empty to go back to the original label.
history.hint: Changes from the import are undone with “revert” on the passage.
assign.title: Classify call
library.name: Name
library.folder_hint: Calls, audio and the database of this company live here. Backing up = copying this folder. A folder that already has a library.db is reused.
client.name: Client name
search.title: Results for “{q}”
search.hint: accents are ignored; words match by prefix
import.title: Import
import.intro: Brings in calls from the old pipeline: call_*.txt (and _v2 as a new version), call_*.mic.wav / .sys.wav (copied as FLAC) and edits made in the HTML prototype. Original files are never deleted or moved.
import.target_hint: Calls already imported stay where they are. You can classify them later.
import.reclaim_hint: The app never deletes originals. Delete them yourself once you have checked the imported calls.
import.reclaim_none: No imported originals left on disk.
settings.title: Settings
settings.me_hint: Shown instead of “Me” in every call.
settings.data_dir_hint: Holds unclassified calls and settings. Change it with: rstt settings data-dir <folder>
settings.companies_hint: Each company/project is a folder of its own with calls, audio and database.
settings.unregister_confirm: “{name}” leaves the app, but the folder {path} stays on disk with everything in it. You can add it back later.
settings.cli_hint: The same program works in the terminal (JSON output). Changes made there show up here right away and can be undone.
error.schema_too_new: Created by a newer version of the app
glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.intro: Fixes for words the transcription gets wrong, kept just for you. Two layers: global rules apply everywhere and each client can override them. Nothing changes in a call until you apply the glossary to it.
glossary.ctx_global_hint: These rules apply to every call, unless a client has its own rule for the same pattern.
glossary.ctx_client_hint: Client rules come first and override global rules with the same pattern (those are greyed out).
glossary.replace_hint: Swaps whole words after transcription, ignoring upper/lower case unless the rule is case-sensitive. A match in ALL CAPS stays in caps, a capitalized one stays capitalized.
glossary.term_hint: Terms do not change any text. When transcription inside the app arrives (phase 4) they are sent to the model as vocabulary hints, which biases it toward these spellings without guaranteeing them. Keep the list short.
glossary.empty_replace: No replacements here yet. Edit a passage in a call and the app will offer to create one.
glossary.empty_term: No terms here yet. Add the names and jargon the model should expect.
glossary.overridden: Overridden by the client rule with the same pattern.
glossary.case_hint: Only matches this exact upper/lower case
glossary.promote_hint: Move this rule to the global layer
glossary.promote_confirm: “{pattern}” will apply to every client, and the copy in this client is removed.
glossary.remove_confirm: Remove “{what}” from the glossary? Text already changed by it stays as it is.
glossary.f_pattern_hint: Whole words; spaces match any amount of spaces; punctuation is literal. Up to 200 characters.
glossary.f_case_hint: Off by default: “zenit”, “Zenit” and “ZENIT” are the same.
glossary.prompt_usage: {fit} of {total} terms fit in the model prompt
glossary.prompt_over: The terms that do not fit are cut off. Remove the least useful ones.
glossary.imp_format: UTF-8 text, one entry per line. “wrong -> right” (also → and =>) is a replacement, anything else is a term. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
glossary.apply_hint: Apply the replacement rules to this whole call (you review before it is saved)
glossary.apply_none: Nothing to change: no rule matches this call.
glossary.apply_undo_hint: Everything is saved as one step: Ctrl+Z undoes the whole batch.
glossary.applied_one: Glossary applied (1 passage) · Ctrl+Z to undo
glossary.applied_other: Glossary applied ({n} passages) · Ctrl+Z to undo
glossary.err.conflict: A rule of this type with this pattern already exists in this layer.
glossary.err.invalid: Invalid entry: the pattern and the replacement cannot be empty or identical (limits: 200 and 500 characters).
glossary.err.not_found: Not found: the rule or client may have been removed.
glossary.err.promote_conflict: A global rule with this pattern already has a different replacement. Edit or remove one of them first.
glossary.err.import_invalid: The file must be UTF-8 text up to 2 MB.
glossary.err.same: The replacement must differ from the pattern.
suggest.title: Add a glossary rule
suggest.occurrences_none: does not appear in other passages
suggest.widen_hint: You can edit both sides, e.g. widen the pattern to two words so it does not catch a common word.
suggest.no_client: This call has no client, so only a global rule can be created. Classify the call to get per-client rules.
record.speakers: How many people on the other side?
record.speakers_hint: Helps separate the voices in the transcript (1 to 20).
record.both_off: Turn on at least the microphone or the system audio.
record.no_backend: Audio server not found (PulseAudio, or PipeWire with Pulse compatibility). Recording is not possible without it.
record.mic_silent: No microphone audio for {s} s. Is it muted, or is this the wrong device?
record.sys_silent: System audio silent for {s} s (normal if nobody is talking).
record.cuts_one: 1 reconnection during recording: a short stretch may be silent.
record.cuts_other: {n} reconnections during recording: short stretches may be silent.
record.err_speakers: People count: use a whole number from 1 to 20 (or leave it empty).
record.done: Recording saved as a new call, waiting for transcription.
record.toast_empty: Nothing was recorded: the recording was empty and was discarded.
record.warn_monitor: System audio captures everything the computer plays (calls, videos, notifications), not just the meeting.
record.warn_screen: When you share the whole screen, the mini bar and this window are visible to others. On Linux they cannot be hidden from capture: share a specific window or tab instead.
record.warn_consent: Capturing system audio can record other people's voices. Tell the participants and get consent where the law or company policy requires it.
recovery.title: Recordings to recover
recovery.intro: The app closed (or the system crashed) during these recordings. The audio captured up to that point is saved: recover it to create the call, or discard it.
transcription.pending_body: This call's audio is saved and will be transcribed automatically, one call at a time.
transcription.running_body: Transcription is running in the background. The text will appear here when it finishes.
settings.record.title: Recording
settings.record.devices_hint: Used by the shortcut, the tray and the command line; on the Record screen you can change them each time.
settings.record.bar_on_start: Show the mini bar when recording starts
settings.record.shortcut_hint: Click the field and press the combination (use Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Super).
settings.record.shortcut_unsupported: The global shortcut only works on X11 sessions; this session is {session}. Use your compositor's shortcut to run “rstt record toggle”.
settings.record.wayland_other: Wayland session: the app's global shortcut does not work. Bind a key in your compositor to the command
settings.record.hypr_title: Wayland / Hyprland: bar window and shortcut
settings.record.hypr_intro: On Hyprland the app cannot keep itself on top or position itself. These rules make the mini bar float, stay pinned on every workspace, not steal focus and sit in the top-right corner, and bind Ctrl+Alt+R to recording.
settings.record.hypr_version: The syntax depends on your Hyprland version (it changed in recent releases). Check yours with “hyprctl version” and use the matching block; after pasting, reload the configuration.
settings.record.hypr_note_title: The rule matches the window's initial title (“rstt-bar”), which the app sets on creation.
settings.record.hypr_note_bind: The “bind” runs the command line tool, which starts the app if it is not running.
error.already_recording: A recording is already in progress
error.device_open_failed: Could not open the audio device
transcription.setup_body: Transcription runs on this computer. A one-time download of about 1.7 GB is needed (speech models and the Python environment).
transcription.queued_body: This call is queued and will be transcribed next.
transcription.setup_needed: Transcription still needs to be set up (Settings).
queue.title: Transcription queue
queue.paused_recording: Paused while you record; it resumes by itself afterwards.
queue.cancel_confirm: Cancel this transcription? Partial progress is discarded.
call.rediarize_speakers: How many people on the other side? (empty = the call's value)
call.no_raw: This version was imported: voices cannot be separated again.
call.bleed_hint: Parts of your microphone discarded because they repeated the system audio. If one was really you, use “Without the echo filter”.
settings.transcription.title: Transcription
settings.transcription.hotwords: Use glossary terms to help the transcription
settings.transcription.low_priority: Low priority (does not slow the rest of the computer)
settings.transcription.bleed_filter: Echo filter (microphone repeating the system audio)
error.worker_protocol: Invalid reply from the transcription process
error.no_raw_data: This version has no data to redo
queue.already_open: This call already has a transcription in the queue.
transcription.setup_cancelled: Setup cancelled. What was already downloaded is kept and you can resume.
transcription.pending_body_manual: This call's audio is saved. Automatic transcription is off: start it whenever you like.
call.rediarize_hint: Reuses the transcription and only redoes who said each passage. Creates a new version.
call.resegment_hint: Rebuilds the blocks from data already computed, without processing the audio. Creates a new version.
call.resegment_nobleed_hint: Like rebuilding, but without discarding microphone passages as echo.
call.retranscribe_hint: Transcribes the whole audio again. Takes a while; creates a new version.
transcription.queued_hint: In the queue; it will be transcribed next.
